KeysToEntries.Penguin.Name: Penguins
KeysToEntries.Facade.Name: Fishy Façade
KeysToEntries.Player.GenderNeutral.Password.1: The Pidgeon Flies Left in Winter?
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.2: What? Huh? That's not a thing. Who recruited you? Terry? I bet it was Terry, he never tells people nothing.
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.3: Ok, look. You know why you're here. You know what's at stake.
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.4: Good. Great. Penguins! The most dangerous force across all of Gielinor. Dragons? HA! Don't make me laugh, the penguins are the real threat here and they'll DESTROY US ALL!
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.5: Agents of the KGP have already infiltrated Ashenfall. Even now they're observing what you do and plotting ways to take us all down.
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.6: Our sources tell us that the agents rotate out every week, spread across the entire continent, and limit themselves to only six active agents at any one time. They could be disguised as anything - barrels, bushes, unusually large bees.
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.7: I need you to find these agents. Observe their disguises and report back to me. For each one you observe you'll gain a coin, return to me and I can trade them in for useful stuff!
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.Intro.8: Go! Put a stop to the penguin menace before it's too late!
KeysToEntries.Facade.Male.SpokenTo.1: Only owls know the secret song in summer. Don't you agree comrad.... err... friend?
KeysToEntries.Player.GenderNeutral.WhatDoIDo: What do i need to do again?
